Verified: events transcription.completed, summary.completed/regenerated/updated, action_items.regenerated/updated, speakers.labeled, transcript.edited, recording.created/deleted/merged, translation.completed, mind_map.completed; POST JSON, 30s timeout, 3 attempts with 1-30s backoff, at-least-once; HMAC-SHA256 signature + ms timestamp headers; payload carries recording meta, summarizations (summary, action items) and transcript segments with speakers+times, no audio; personal webhooks set in app integrations UI, secret shown once
Webhook retries end after 3 attempts over ~30s, so downtime loses events; list has a documented 429 with no numbers, so polling must back off and stay coarse

Community reader uses production.heypocketai.com with a Chrome-extracted Firebase token (1h); ToS prohibits automated access for unauthorized purposes and device reverse engineering (quotes via summarizing fetch, verify before relying). With an official API this path is unnecessary risk
No SLA; marketing says 'seconds', one review ~1 min after sync; clock starts at phone sync. Low confidence — measure empirically via recordingAt vs createdAt

obligations.behavior: local and mongo satisfy one Sink contract
obligations.source_text: MongoDB is a third sink adapter (mongo) beside local and s3, behind the same sink interface planned in CLAUDE.md 'Target architecture' and issue #1 item 2 ('behind one interface so more can be added later') — not a parallel pipeline

obligations.behavior: pocketsync and the local sink import without pymongo
obligations.source_text: pymongo goes behind an optional extra (pocketsync[mongo]) and is imported lazily; core and local sink stay zero-dependency; tests use a fake/in-memory Mongo (mongomock or stub) in the dev group

obligations.behavior: identical re-delivery leaves content_hash and updated_at unchanged
obligations.source_text: Mongo writes are idempotent upserts keyed by recording id with content hash; re-sync only on hash change, so a re-run with no remote changes is a no-op (issue #1 item 3)

obligations.behavior: no tracked mongodb:// URI with credentials or non-localhost host
obligations.source_text: Mongo connection URI comes from env/git-ignored config only; no mongodb:// URI with credentials or non-localhost host is ever committed — scan-secrets.py flags secret-ish assignments, and JSON endpoint check covers only http(s) url/host keys, so a mongodb:// URI would NOT be caught by the endpoint check and needs discipline (or a scanner extension)

obligations.behavior: one event per new/changed recording with id, sinks, hash, change
obligations.source_text: Each new/updated recording also emits the handoff event (events.jsonl and/or an events-cli publish); culture-rules triggers on a durable events-cli subscription (culture_rules/events/ingest.py), so near-realtime downstream reaction needs the events-cli publish, not only the jsonl file

obligations.behavior: bad/missing/stale signatures rejected with 401, nothing written
obligations.source_text: Near-realtime path is push: a pocketsync webhook receiver accepts Pocket POSTs, verifies X-HeyPocket-Signature (HMAC-SHA256 hex of '{timestamp}.{rawBody}' with the webhook secret) against raw body bytes, rejects stale timestamps, dedupes at-least-once deliveries, and upserts the recording into Mongo

obligations.behavior: a webhook missed while the receiver is down is recovered by reconcile
obligations.source_text: A polling reconciler (the planned 'watch' verb) backs up the webhooks: list recordings with start_date overlap (e.g. 2 days), compare updated_at/content hash, fetch details for changes, and back off on HTTP 429 — so missed webhooks (receiver down beyond Pocket's 3 attempts) still converge

obligations.behavior: no reverse-engineered API or browser token path
obligations.source_text: pocketsync does NOT use the reverse-engineered production.heypocketai.com API or scraped Firebase browser tokens — Pocket's ToS (heypocket.com/pages/terms, 2025-09-15) bars automated access 'for unauthorized purposes', while the official pk_ key is authorized by design

obligations.behavior: secrets read from env/config only and never rendered
obligations.source_text: The Pocket pk_ API key and webhook signing secret live only in env vars / keyring / git-ignored config (e.g. POCKETSYNC_API_KEY, POCKETSYNC_WEBHOOK_SECRET), never in tracked files; scan-secrets.py's token/secret assignment rule is the CI backstop

obligations.behavior: receiver binds 127.0.0.1 only
obligations.source_text: pocketsync.culture.dev is provisioned with `cultureflare remote-login setup` as a remote-managed Cloudflare tunnel to a loopback-only pocketsync receiver (`http://127.0.0.1:<port>`, never 0.0.0.0), with cloudflared run as a systemd user unit whose tunnel token is injected from grant, mirroring culture-rules cloudflared-rules.service

obligations.behavior: runbook keeps Access on and bypasses only /hooks/pocket
obligations.source_text: Cloudflare Access stays on pocketsync.culture.dev; only the exact path pocketsync.culture.dev/hooks/pocket gets a Bypass (Include: Everyone) Access app, never widened to /hooks/* or /, and the receiver's HMAC signature check is the auth for that path (decision c34)

obligations.behavior: stored vectors are 768-d from gemma2-embed
obligations.source_text: Embeddings are requested from spark's lobes gateway (POST http://localhost:8001/v1/embeddings, model 'gemma2-embed', OpenAI-compatible, Authorization: Bearer key from env), which mesh-proxies to the Orin; vectors are 768-d L2-normalised and the model id is stored on the doc so a future model switch is a detectable re-embed

obligations.behavior: transcripts over 8192 tokens yield multiple chunk vectors with times
obligations.source_text: Transcripts longer than gemma2-embed's 8192-token window are chunked (e.g. by transcript segments) and stored as per-chunk vectors with segment time ranges, alongside one summary-level vector, so long meetings stay searchable

obligations.behavior: gateway 503 leaves recording landed and enrichment pending
obligations.source_text: Enrichment (embedding + classification) never blocks or fails the Pocket landing: the doc is upserted first with enrichment status 'pending', enrichment runs after and retries, and an Orin/gateway outage (503/404 from a stopped lane — no cross-lane fallback) leaves docs pending, not lost

obligations.behavior: audio hash on disk matches doc; partial download never leaves final file
obligations.source_text: Audio lands via GET audio-download-url (pre-signed URL, expires_in 60-86400s) into the local file layout `<root>/<YYYY>/<MM>/<recording-id>/audio.<ext>` with an atomic temp-file + rename; the Mongo doc stores only the relative path, size, content hash and download time, never the bytes. The webhook carries no audio, so audio is fetched after the receiver or poller sees the recording

obligations.behavior: data lives in host bind mounts incl. mongot, fixed hostname
obligations.source_text: pocketsync-mongo (docker compose, mongodb/mongodb-atlas-local image) bind-mounts /data/db, /data/configdb and the mongot index directory (v9) to host dirs OUTSIDE the public repo tree (e.g. ~/.local/share/pocketsync/mongo/), restart: unless-stopped, and publishes only 127.0.0.1:27019 (27017/27018 are taken); the audio/file root likewise lives outside the repo (e.g. ~/.local/share/pocketsync/files)

obligations.behavior: second pass with no remote changes performs 0 writes and 0 events
obligations.source_text: With webhooks disabled, the reconciler lands a new recording within <= 1 polling interval (default 5 min) and a re-run with no remote changes performs 0 Mongo writes and emits 0 events

obligations.behavior: one process runs all loops and stops cleanly on SIGTERM
obligations.source_text: A long-running `pocketsync serve` verb runs the webhook receiver (loopback HTTP, stdlib http.server or similar, zero core deps), the reconciler loop and the enrichment worker in one process, installed as a systemd user unit; `watch` is the reconciler-only loop and `sync --apply` a one-shot pass

obligations.behavior: restart causes no duplicate writes or events
obligations.source_text: Sync state (reconcile watermark, webhook dedupe keys, last run, errors) persists in a pocketsync-mongo collection separate from the recordings collection, so a restart resumes without re-processing and 'pocketsync status --json' reports it

obligations.behavior: taxonomy change needs no code change
obligations.source_text: The decider classification questions (label taxonomy, descriptions, single/multi-label, extra yes/no filters) are read from config, not hard-coded, so the taxonomy (open question q8) can change without a code change; a taxonomy change marks docs for re-classification

obligations.behavior: default test run makes no network calls
obligations.source_text: Tests run without network: a fake Pocket adapter (synthetic fixtures only, no URL keys or localhost-only per scan-secrets), a fake Mongo/stub for unit tests, a fake gateway for embed/decider; one opt-in integration test (env-gated) runs against a real atlas-local container to exercise $vectorSearch

obligations.behavior: dry-run of each write verb performs 0 writes
obligations.source_text: Every new verb follows the repo CLI contract: write verbs dry-run by default and commit only with --apply, --json on every verb, CliError with remediation, results on stdout and diagnostics on stderr

obligations.behavior: an enrichment for an old content hash is never persisted
obligations.source_text: Content writes (receiver/reconciler) and enrichment writes (worker) touch disjoint field groups via targeted $set, and an enrichment result is written only if the doc's content hash still equals the hash it was computed from (compare-and-set); a content change resets enrichment to pending, so a slow embed never overwrites newer content or leaves stale vectors

obligations.behavior: 2xx sent before any outbound call
obligations.source_text: The webhook receiver verifies the signature, durably records the event (dedupe key) and returns 2xx in <= 2 s; fetching details, audio and enrichment happen asynchronously after the ack, so Pocket's 30 s timeout and 3-attempt retry never fire because pocketsync is slow

obligations.behavior: doc identical via webhook or reconciler
obligations.source_text: A webhook is treated as a trigger, not the record: after ack, pocketsync fetches GET /public/recordings/{id} (include_transcript, include_summarizations) and builds the doc from that canonical response, because the webhook transcript can be excluded by configuration and staged events carry partial state

obligations.behavior: no unverified body is stored or processed
obligations.source_text: The /hooks/pocket receiver fails closed: unsigned requests (Pocket's legacy unsigned webhooks, possibly org webhooks) are rejected, oversized bodies (> a configured limit, e.g. 5 MB) are refused before HMAC, and only personal-webhook signatures with a configured secret are accepted

obligations.behavior: the Pocket adapter exposes no write methods
obligations.source_text: pocketsync only reads from Pocket: it never calls mutating Pocket endpoints (update action items, uploads, org admin), even though the pk_ key may permit them

obligations.behavior: broken webhook path visible in status within one reconcile interval
obligations.source_text: pocketsync status --json reports webhook-path health: last verified webhook time, count of recordings the reconciler found that no webhook delivered (a non-zero rate means the push path is broken: tunnel down, Access bypass gone, secret rotated), enrichment backlog and last errors; doctor flags each as a check

obligations.behavior: every landed/updated recording eventually publishes once per content hash
obligations.source_text: Handoff events are published with events_cli EventClient.publish_event at QoS 1 (QoS 0 bypasses durable capture) behind an optional extra (pocketsync[events]), once per content hash after enrichment completes (decision c59); an append-only events.jsonl in the file root doubles as an outbox so a broker-down publish is retried, never lost

obligations.behavior: backfill completes without restarts and respects concurrency cap
obligations.source_text: First run backfills history: 'pocketsync sync --since <date> --apply' pages list recordings (limit 100), honours 429 with backoff, and throttles enrichment to a configurable concurrency so a backlog of hundreds of recordings doesn't saturate the Orin lanes shared with the mesh

obligations.behavior: vectors from two models/dims never coexist in one index
obligations.source_text: pocketsync creates the vector search index idempotently (numDimensions from the configured model, similarity cosine or dotProduct, filter fields for type labels and dates) and refuses to run if the configured model/dimensions differ from the index and stored docs, until an explicit 're-embed --apply' rebuilds them

obligations.behavior: all five harness files describe the official API and the harness config probes pass
obligations.source_text: The CLAUDE.md 'Verify the API premise first' section (and the three sibling harness files AGENTS.override.md/.pi/SYSTEM.md, AGENTS.colleague.md, QWEN.md) is updated: the Firebase/reverse-engineered premise is superseded by the official API + webhooks, which answers issue #1's first deliverable

obligations.behavior: docs are queryable with $vectorSearch plus type filters on a real atlas-local
obligations.source_text: Within seconds of Pocket finishing a recording, pocketsync-mongo holds one document for it (metadata, speaker-attributed transcript segments, summary, action items, audio file path and hash, 768-d gemma2-embed chunk + summary vectors, decider type labels), queryable with $vectorSearch plus type filters, and a handoff event is emitted; data survives container restarts and re-creation

obligations.behavior: a recording made after go-live appears in pocketsync-mongo with no manual step (h1) — needs deploy, issue #3
obligations.source_text: pocketsync keeps a local MongoDB continuously up to date with every Pocket recording's transcript, summary, action items and metadata, landing new recordings as close to realtime as Pocket's API limits allow

obligations.behavior: p95 webhook->doc <= 10 s and ->enriched <= 60 s on >= 10 real deliveries (h6) — needs real recordings, issue #3
obligations.source_text: p95 latency from Pocket's summary.completed webhook delivery to the recording document being present in pocketsync-mongo is <= 10 s, and to vectors + type labels being present is <= 60 s while the Orin lanes are up

obligations.behavior: container re-create keeps count, vectors and index with 0 re-embeds on the real stack (h8) — throwaway-only so far, issue #3
obligations.source_text: After docker compose down && up (container re-created) the recording count, vectors and vector-search index are unchanged and the first $vectorSearch returns results with 0 re-embeds

obligations.behavior: operator confirms the owned searchable copy is the goal (h4)
obligations.source_text: An owned, near-realtime, semantically searchable copy of every recording (filterable by type) makes Pocket data usable by local agents and rules within seconds, and survives Pocket API changes or account loss

obligations.behavior: both audiences can read the doc schema from README alone (h2) — manual review by readers pending
obligations.source_text: The operator on spark who wants every Pocket recording searchable in a store they own, plus the mesh agents and culture-rules workflows that read pocketsync-mongo and react to pocketsync's events
